newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian music producer Gulshan Kumar shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Indian music producer Gulshan Kumar shot dead.

text.p: Gulshan Kumar, a prominent figure in Bombay's film industry, was shot dead by unidentified gunmen on Tuesday morning, police said.
"Gulshan Kumar had gone to a temple and was coming out after prayers when he was shot at by people from inside a taxi," a police official said.
"He was hit several times. Although he was rushed to the hospital, he was declared dead on arrival," the official said.
He said no other details were available, either about the number of assailants or their identity.
Gulshan Kumar was a well-known personality in show business in Bombay. He was the owner of a music recording and marketing company and had produced and directed several Hindi films.
